searchText: gevurah — reality and constraints the awtsmoos gives infinite light a disciplined vessel; truth must precede marketing on awtsmoos.com. verified peruta purchase is server authoritative and idempotent. purchased and promotional peruta are distinct. universal supporter tiers and consumable product credit packs already exist. generic credit consumption already exists and is tested against concurrency/idempotency. the global ui foundation already mounts product commerce. 76 catalog products are represented in the front end catalog while current backend filesystem discovery yields 69 commerce identities. eleven catalog identities are missing from backend discovery; several are external root routes, one is nested, and one aliases the captions route. apps/games hub inventories are dynamically rendered and therefore weak for crawler visible merchandising. hard rules never invent client authoritative prices. never market unavailable fulfillment. never create pay to win, gambling, hidden scarcity, or deceptive depletion. never sell credits without a meaningful redemption path. preserve dirty/uncommitted user work. full file rewrites only; touched source under 120 lines; tabs; no compressed statements. every touched js starts with exact b"h / boruch hashem / blessed be he lines and extensive jsdoc.

searchText: attack plan — thirty failure questions 1. can nested routes vanish from commerce? 2. can root level apps vanish from commerce? 3. can two catalog identities share one physical route? 4. can a renamed product strand credits? 5. can a marketplace badge infer the wrong product from url shape? 6. can static marketing claim commerce when server catalog disagrees? 7. can a credit pack exist without a consume action? 8. can a duplicate purchase charge twice? 9. can concurrent credit consumes overdraw? 10. can a failed job consume credits without delivering value? 11. can checkout erase user work? 12. can offline ui imply payment success? 13. can promotional and purchased peruta be confused? 14. can bought credits silently expire? 15. can reward faucets inflate liabilities? 16. can a 360px screen hide purchase actions? 17. can safe area insets cover launchers? 18. can focus escape a dialog? 19. can reduced motion users avoid costly animation? 20. can shared commerce css break editors or games? 21. can catalog cards overflow or become noisy? 22. can crawler visible pages remain empty despite rich runtime catalogs? 23. can product routes 404 while marketplace cards remain active? 24. can unknown sku metadata enter client display? 25. can analytics leak private project content? 26. can a disabled sku remain advertised? 27. can product readiness regress without ci failure? 28. can server and browser normalize identity differently? 29. can future developers understand every mapping without archaeology? 30. can the next agent resume directly from remaining work?
